## Requirements (contract §In scope)

1. Define the unit + metric (resolved site = cluster of observation-level records of one physical device;
   M, N ≤ M, dedup ratio 1 − N/M) — record in methodology copy + eval report; redefine
   `resolved_sites_metric` and every consumer.
2. Geospatial blocking rule(s) in `blocking_rules.toml` + code, sized against the ceiling; candidates only.
3. Matcher + tiers (distance, shared canonical ref, operator/type compatibility, source independence); test-pin
   (a) never merge same source, (b) no merge across conflicting types/operators beyond recorded rules, (c) a
   mirror is not independent corroboration. Lat/lon resolved jointly (hand-off).
4. Eval before auto-write: stratified camera gold set (dense urban, highway corridor, rural singleton,
   cross-source mirror), agent seed + LLM adjudicator, κ ≥ 0.7 to trust LLM labels, frozen agent-verified
   holdout, auto-write only tiers with measured holdout precision ≥ 0.98, sub-floor → review; cluster-shape
   alerts catch chaining.
5. Hosted ER run in GCP via `sig-materialize` on a uniquely tagged image as `sig_materialize`; append-only;
   measure M, N, ratio, per-tier precision, demotions, alerts; re-run +0; honest ETA.
6. ADR (next free = ADR-105), revisit trigger, BL-057, Appendix F + BUILD.sh, ADR index; regenerate the eval
   report scale section from committed measurements; close D-P30.2-3.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1 resolved-site definition + metric recorded and used consistently.
- AC2 geospatial blocking + matcher with same-source exclusion, mirror-independence and type/operator
  constraints test-pinned.
- AC3 eval: κ recorded, frozen verified holdout, per-tier precision; auto-write only ≥ 0.98; sub-floor → review;
  cluster-shape alerts run.
- AC4 hosted ER run in GCP materializes decisions; measured N and dedup ratio (> 0 or an honest 0); re-run +0.
- AC5 ADR written; eval report regenerated; D-P30.2-3 closed; `make check` + `make test-db` + validators green.

## Plan

1. Measure first (read-only pull of the hosted spine over `cloud-sql-proxy --token` as `sig`): 230,330 camera
   records with a coordinate pair across 180+ sources, 0 multi-source subjects; cross-source pairs ≤ 1 m: 6,779
   (republished copies), same-source pairs ≤ 1 m: 36,437 (co-located devices / coarse coordinates).
2. Design: clusters as a separate append-only decision layer over per-source subjects (no entity UPDATE);
   `camera_site_match` + `camera_site_run` (completion marker); proposals → `review_item`.
3. Build `blocking.GeoGridRule`, `resolution.camera_sites` (tiers, constraints, clustering, alerts, gold,
   measurement), `resolution.camera_sites_pg` (reader, batched writer, read seam), CLI + `materialize.sh` step,
   metric redefinition in `exports.spine_export`, eval-report section, web copy.
4. Gold: stratified sample, blind agent labels, blind fresh-context LLM adjudication, measure, iterate only on the
   training partition, fresh holdout for any rule change.
5. Hosted: sqitch deploy (owner), SHA-tagged image, job upsert, run, +0 re-run, read-only measurement → commit.

## Progress

- Branch created from `84597f1`; hosted pull (read-only) → overlap analysis (above).
- Implemented blocking/matcher/materializer/metric; local preview over the pull: 3 s end-to-end.
- Gold v1 (`camera-1`, 360 pairs, stratified by tier × stratum, seed 30): agent labels blind to tier; LLM
  adjudicator = a fresh-context subagent given only the written rules + the evidence sheet. κ 0.663. Holdout
  (108): tier 1g 30/34 = 0.882, 3g 39/42 = 0.929 → both demoted (nothing would auto-write). **The holdout misses
  were then printed while diagnosing → holdout contaminated → retired to training.**
- Rules v2 derived from TRAINING-partition errors only (shared refs at points where a publisher lists several
  devices; opposed viewing directions). Training partition under v2: 1g 51/51, 3g 72/72 (development, not a
  measurement). Fresh holdout (180 pairs, seed 302, disjoint, drawn after the change) labelled blind (agent +
  a second fresh LLM run): **1g 70/70 = 1.000, 3g 69/70 = 0.986**, 4g 0.300, 5g 0.250 (0.263 after the tie
  fix); κ 0.667 (holdout),
  0.669 (all 540). Gold `camera-2` committed (coordinate-free).
- Checkpoint commit `29b75f8`; `make check` 3,871 passed / 3 skipped.

  first pass `sig-materialize-l2frp` 11:01:12→11:06:49Z (N 227,999); +0 re-run `sig-materialize-8zm8p`.
